scope: Read-only deadline/extension/end_turn route diagnosis for installed Co-Engineer 3.4.2.

supported: inspectTask extension fields persist a later task deadline and extension event
the worker deadline watch rereads the task record on task-directory changes
controller waiters reread and use an updated task deadline
conclusion.limitation: runAcpTask captures timeoutMs once and passes it into the already-created ACPX runtime/turn; the bundled runtime creates a fixed per-prompt withTimeout timer and exposes no inspected retroactive update path
conclusion.uncertainty: The permitted receipts do not distinguish natural provider end_turn from ACPX timeout fallback or establish whether the outer worker watch rearmed on the historical extension. Timeout expiry, failed extension propagation, and authentication failure are unproven.

Extension validation and deadline computation from extension time.
One-time timeout capture, dynamic outer worker watch, and fixed timeout passed to ACP runtime/turn.
Fixed withTimeout timer, timeout passed to runPromptTurn, and stopReason propagation; generated bundle lines are intentionally minified.
Atomic task-record update and dynamic waiter deadline rereads.

skill.supports: Pre-expiry strictly-later extension rule and wait/provider lifecycle boundary.
